finalText:
Found and finished the leftover spots. 12 files across 6 packages were still calling the old `db.query`, each in three places: a get-by-id lookup, a list query, and an update. All 36 calls now use `db.execute({ sql, params })` instead, and all 12 files check out with a syntax check.

One file I left alone on purpose: `vendor/legacy-orm/adapter.js`. It's marked as a vendored copy that gets overwritten wholesale on every upgrade, so any edit there would just get lost.
